hunks.baseline: There was an old saying passed down among Hunters.
hunks.sol: There was an old saying among Hunters.

hunks.baseline: Mages came in two kinds: archmages, and everyone else.
hunks.sol: Mages came in two kinds: Grand Mages, and everyone else.

hunks.baseline: Magic Johnson had proven that saying true with his own body.
hunks.sol: Magic Johnson had proven that saying true firsthand.

hunks.baseline: Among the seven billion people on Earth, there were only three archmages.
hunks.sol: Among the seven billion people on Earth, there were only three Grand Mages.

hunks.baseline: And even among those three, he was the strongest War Mage. During the Great Cataclysm, he had slain countless monsters and led innumerable battles to victory.
hunks.sol: And of those three, he was the strongest War Mage. During the Great Cataclysm, he had slain countless monsters and led innumerable battles to victory.

hunks.baseline: But even Magic Johnson, despite all those incredible achievements, had encountered someone before whom he had been forced to swallow his pride.
hunks.sol: Yet even Magic Johnson, for all his incredible achievements, had encountered a being before whom he was forced to swallow his pride.

hunks.baseline: *I hate to say this, but the Arch Lich’s magic is a level above mine. Be careful, Jin.*
hunks.sol: *I hate to say this, but the Arch Lich’s magic is a cut above mine. Be careful, Jin.*

hunks.baseline: The Arch Lich was that powerful. There could be no hesitation or carelessness—not even for an instant—when facing it.
hunks.sol: That was how powerful the Arch Lich was. There could be no hesitation or carelessness—not even for an instant—when facing it.

hunks.baseline: I let the Skeleton Warlord’s shriek wash in one ear and out the other as I poured internal energy into both legs.
hunks.sol: I let the Skeleton Warlord’s shriek go in one ear and out the other as I poured internal energy into both legs.

hunks.baseline: The solid concrete floor sank beneath me, unable to withstand the pressure transmitted into it. I bent my knees slightly, then kicked off with all my strength.
hunks.sol: The solid concrete floor sank beneath me, unable to withstand the pressure. I bent my knees slightly, then kicked off with all my strength.

hunks.baseline: With a thunderous roar like an explosion, I shot into the air like a streak of light.
hunks.sol: With a thunderous roar like an exploding bomb, I shot into the air like a streak of light.

hunks.baseline: The fierce wind swept across my entire body, and the Arch Lich’s form rapidly drew closer, its black robe spread like wings.
hunks.sol: A fierce wind tore across my body, and the Arch Lich rapidly drew closer, its black robe spread like wings.

hunks.baseline: The creature’s trembling red eyes.
hunks.sol: Its trembling red eyes.

hunks.baseline: White Flame, launched with all my strength, had shattered the invisible barrier surrounding the Arch Lich and was now falling with everything it had.
hunks.sol: White Flame, launched with all my strength, had shattered the invisible barrier surrounding the Arch Lich and was now hurtling downward.

hunks.baseline: I stretched out my hand. The shaft of White Flame, pulled across several meters with Seizing an Object Through Empty Space, landed in my grasp.
hunks.sol: I stretched out my hand. Seizing an Object Through Empty Space caught White Flame’s shaft from several meters away and pulled it into my grasp.

hunks.baseline: I thrust the spear forward with all my strength. Three jiazi of Scorching Yang Qi surged up from my dantian and raced onward without restraint. Blue Force, like hellfire, erupted over the transparent spearhead.
hunks.sol: I thrust the spear with all my strength. Three jiazi of Scorching Yang Qi surged up from my dantian and raced forward without restraint. Force like blue hellfire erupted over the transparent spearhead.

hunks.baseline: And just as I became certain of my success—
hunks.sol: And just as I became certain I had succeeded—

hunks.baseline: Along with that sinister voice, something invisible pressed down on my entire body.
hunks.sol: With that sinister voice, something invisible pressed down on my entire body.

hunks.baseline: I swallowed a breath and reached out as far as I could, but before the spearhead brimming with Force could touch the Arch Lich’s foot, my body was already falling toward the ground.
hunks.sol: I caught my breath and stretched my arm as far as I could, but before the spearhead brimming with Force could touch the Arch Lich’s foot, I was already plummeting toward the ground.

hunks.baseline: The Arch Lich’s form, which had seemed close enough to touch, receded in an instant.
hunks.sol: The Arch Lich, which had seemed close enough to touch, receded in an instant.

hunks.baseline: As I crashed down like a meteor, a laugh like scraping metal rang out above my head.
hunks.sol: I crashed down like a meteor. Above my head, laughter like scraping metal rang out.

hunks.baseline: —Not bad. That was rather entertaining.
hunks.sol: —Not bad. Amusing in its own way.

hunks.baseline: I spat thickly and looked up at the Arch Lich looming over me as though it were a god.
hunks.sol: I spat out a wad of phlegm and looked up at the Arch Lich looming over me like a god.

hunks.baseline: —Humans are always dreaming futile dreams. I have seen it countless times: you challenge what cannot be surpassed, driven by anger and longing, only to finally realize reality and fall into despair.
hunks.sol: —Humans are always dreaming futile dreams. I have seen it countless times. Driven by anger and longing, you challenge what cannot be surpassed, only to confront reality at last and fall into despair.

hunks.baseline: “That sounds a lot like the bullshit spewed by all the guys who’ve died by my hand… Do you people share a *Hundred Questions and Answers for Dealing with Jin Taekyung* or something? Do you hold study sessions every now and then, too?”
hunks.sol: “That sounds a lot like the bullshit spewed by all the guys who’ve died by my hand… Do you people share a *Hundred Questions and Answers for Dealing with Jin Taekyung* or something? Hold study sessions every now and then?”

hunks.baseline: —Even so, those who died by your hand were still insignificant humans. But I am different.
hunks.sol: —Those who died by your hand were still insignificant humans. But I am different.

hunks.baseline: “Looking at your current state, that means someone killed you, too. Was it a human? Why have you been showing off your inferiority complex this whole time?”
hunks.sol: “Looking at you now, someone must’ve killed you, too. Was it a human? Is that why you’ve been flaunting your inferiority complex this whole time?”

hunks.baseline: At the thunderous shout, the magic surrounding the Arch Lich surged violently. Its red eyes had grown far brighter than before as they glared down at me.
hunks.sol: At its thunderous shout, the magic surrounding the Arch Lich surged violently. Its red eyes, far brighter than before, glared down at me.

hunks.baseline: —I am a servant who follows a great king. I am not a being who can be compared to insignificant creatures like you!
hunks.sol: —I am a servant of a great king. I am not a being who can be compared to insignificant creatures like you!

hunks.baseline: I was about to fire back again when I froze at the unexpected word that came from its mouth.
hunks.sol: I was about to fire back when the unexpected word stopped me.

hunks.baseline: A question flashed through my mind, and the Skeleton Warlord answered in a trembling voice.
hunks.sol: As the question flashed through my mind, the Skeleton Warlord answered in a trembling voice.

hunks.baseline: —The commander heard it clearly, too. Wretched human. Th-then, could it be…
hunks.sol: —This commander heard it clearly, too, wretched human. Th-then, could it be…

hunks.baseline: Never say never, I guess.
hunks.sol: So much for *no way*.

hunks.baseline: And it turned out to be the Demon King Asmodeus after all.
hunks.sol: It really was the Demon King Asmodeus.

hunks.baseline: “Yeah, yeah, I get it—he’s fucking adorable. Now answer me. Asmodeus died back then, didn’t he? Or did he resurrect? If he came back as an undead like you, where is he and what’s he doing now?”
hunks.sol: “Yeah, yeah, I get it—he’s fucking adorable. Now answer me. Asmodeus died back then, didn’t he? Or did he come back to life? If he was resurrected as an undead like you, where is he, and what’s he doing now?”

hunks.baseline: At that moment, the Skeleton Warlord murmured in a fearful voice,
hunks.sol: At that moment, the Skeleton Warlord murmured fearfully,

hunks.baseline: —If it is this time of day, he might be sleeping…
hunks.sol: —At this hour, he might be asleep…

hunks.baseline: “What the fuck are you talking about? You don’t sleep, either.”
hunks.sol: “What the fuck are you talking about? You don’t sleep.”

hunks.baseline: “What is the Demon King, some good little schoolboy? Do you think he turns off the television, brushes his teeth, and goes to bed when the sun goes down? And why are you using such an honorific?”
hunks.sol: “What is the Demon King, some model child of the new nation? You think he turns off the television, brushes his teeth, and goes to bed when the sun goes down? And why are you using such an extreme honorific?”

hunks.baseline: —Ah! I did not realize I was doing it… But is it not natural from the commander’s perspective?
hunks.sol: —Ah! I did not even realize… But from this commander’s perspective, is that not only natural?

hunks.baseline: —It is. Because I am a monster.
hunks.sol: —Indeed. Because I am a monster.

hunks.baseline: The Skeleton Warlord let out an exclamation of realization, then added,
hunks.sol: The Skeleton Warlord let out an exclamation of enlightenment, then added,

hunks.baseline: —But, human. It seems the Arch Lich’s magic will be getting closer in a moment.
hunks.sol: —But, human. I believe the Arch Lich’s magic is about to get much closer.

hunks.baseline: I hurriedly threw myself aside. A green mist grazed my body by a hair and covered the spot where I had been standing only a moment before.
hunks.sol: I hurriedly threw myself aside. A green mist grazed me by a hair and engulfed the spot where I had been standing moments earlier.

hunks.baseline: Stone, steel, and even concrete melted away, leaving a gaping hole in a space several dozen meters wide.
hunks.sol: Stone, steel, even concrete—everything within a radius of dozens of meters melted away, leaving a gaping hole.

hunks.baseline: The Arch Lich had fired a poison cloud of terrifying power. Its eyes were not merely clear—they burned like torches.
hunks.sol: The Arch Lich had unleashed a poison cloud of terrifying power. Its eyes now blazed like torches.

hunks.baseline: —I intended to take you as one of my servants.
hunks.sol: —I intended to take you under my command.

hunks.baseline: —I would have subdued your soul and body and used you as the vanguard of my glorious undead army.
hunks.sol: —I would have subdued your body and soul and used you as the vanguard of my glorious undead army.

hunks.baseline: “No, I asked how much it pays. Don’t tell me you people pay in passion, too?”
hunks.sol: “No, I asked how much it pays. Don’t tell me you people pay in passion, too.”

hunks.baseline: “Are you acquainted with the deacon at the church I went to as a kid? He said something similar to me. That a devil like me would go to hell. If my mom hadn’t stopped me, he would’ve become the first martyr in that church’s history.”
hunks.sol: “Are you acquainted with the deacon at the church I went to as a kid? He said something similar to me. Said a devil like me would go to hell. If my mom hadn’t stopped me, he would’ve become the first martyr in that church’s history.”

hunks.baseline: The four-syllable incantation, uttered in a voice deeper and more sinister than ever, was not an answer to my question.
hunks.sol: The four-beat incantation, uttered in a voice deeper and more sinister than ever, was not an answer to my question.

hunks.baseline: A pair of black hands burst through the thick fog. They charged fiercely from both sides, as though coming together in prayer.
hunks.sol: A pair of black hands burst through the thick fog. They hurtled in from both sides as if coming together in prayer.

hunks.baseline: I leaped to avoid the Dark Hands—and another spell was waiting for me.
hunks.sol: I leaped over the Dark Hands—and found another spell waiting for me.

hunks.baseline: I twisted my body to evade the black fog descending like a net, but this time, I was too late.
hunks.sol: I twisted to evade the black fog descending like a net, but this time, I was too late.

hunks.baseline: The fog had already been closing in before I finished dodging the Dark Hands.
hunks.sol: The fog had already been closing in before I even finished dodging the Dark Hands.

hunks.baseline: The difference was no more than a single sheet of paper.
hunks.sol: I escaped by a paper-thin margin.

hunks.baseline: At the instant the sticky fog grazed the tip of my little finger—
hunks.sol: But then the sticky fog grazed the tip of my little finger.

hunks.baseline: As soon as the System notification rang out, I felt my body grow heavier and clicked my tongue inwardly.
hunks.sol: The System notification had barely sounded when my body grew heavier. I clicked my tongue inwardly.

hunks.baseline: Even when I was short on points, I had been hit with a debuff from a curse.
hunks.sol: I was already short on points, and now a curse had slapped me with a debuff.

hunks.baseline: Not one or two points, either. With twenty points stripped away at once from each attribute, I could definitely feel the difference.
hunks.sol: This wasn’t a loss of one or two points, either. With twenty points stripped from each attribute at once, I could clearly feel the difference.

hunks.baseline: But even with a debuff, I was not so helpless that I could do nothing but take his attacks.
hunks.sol: But even with a debuff, I wasn’t so helpless that I would simply let it overwhelm me.

hunks.baseline: Hundreds of thorny vines burst through the ground and filled the air in every direction as they shot toward me.
hunks.sol: Hundreds of thorny vines burst through the ground, filling the air in every direction as they shot toward me.
I exhaled sharply and swung my spear.
*Shhk!*

hunks.baseline: I exhaled briefly and swung my spear. *Shhk.* A line of blue flame traced through the air, slicing apart every vine made of magic.
hunks.sol: A line of blue flame cut through the air, severing every vine formed from magic.

hunks.baseline: From the severed ends of the thorny vines, which had been collapsing after losing their strength, new vines began to grow.
hunks.sol: New vines sprouted from the severed ends of those that had been collapsing.

hunks.sol: They budded, grew thorns, and swelled even larger in barely a second.

hunks.baseline: But one second was the same as a minute to me.
hunks.sol: But to me, one second was as good as a minute.

hunks.baseline: A thorny vine measuring several meters around was cut apart in a single blow.
hunks.sol: A thorny vine several meters around was severed in a single blow.

hunks.baseline: The dark plant, severed from its magical connection, toppled over and crashed into a half-collapsed high-rise building.
hunks.sol: Cut off from its magical connection, the dark plant toppled onto a half-collapsed high-rise building.

hunks.baseline: Through the cloud of dust rising with the thunderous impact, I sensed an ominous wave of energy.
hunks.sol: Amid the cloud of dust rising from the thunderous impact, I sensed an ominous fluctuation of energy.

hunks.baseline: A Bone Spear made entirely of bones became a streak of light and shot toward me.
hunks.sol: A Bone Spear made entirely of bone became a streak of light and shot toward me.

hunks.baseline: The dust cloud exploded with compressed air.
hunks.sol: The dust cloud exploded outward with a blast of compressed air.

hunks.baseline: An uncountable number of Bone Spears surged toward me.
hunks.sol: More Bone Spears than I could possibly count surged toward me.

hunks.baseline: Some flew in straight lines. Some fell like meteors. Others traced curving paths through the air.
hunks.sol: Some flew in straight lines. Some fell like meteors. Others curved through the air.

hunks.baseline: The overwhelming sight left me speechless for a moment.
hunks.sol: The overwhelming sight left me speechless.

hunks.baseline: It was the very situation that sometimes came to me in times of crisis.
hunks.sol: It was that same phenomenon that had sometimes come to me in moments of crisis.

hunks.baseline: My five senses grew razor-sharp, and the world slowed down. In the space between those moments, something unfamiliar came creeping toward me.
hunks.sol: My five senses sharpened to a razor’s edge, and the world slowed down. Into the space between those moments crept something unfamiliar.

hunks.baseline: A sixth sense that could not be explained scientifically.
hunks.sol: A sixth sense that science could not explain.

hunks.baseline: My eyes, sweeping over the enormous net formed by hundreds—thousands—of Bone Spears, gradually slowed.
hunks.sol: My gaze traveled more and more slowly across the enormous net formed by hundreds—thousands—of Bone Spears.

hunks.baseline: *Because I had already given up everything?*
hunks.sol: *Was it because I had already given up?*

hunks.baseline: A form could be layered over it, but the essence itself did not change.
hunks.sol: Appearances could be layered over it, but the essence itself did not change.

hunks.baseline: And at this very moment, I was seeing the essence.
hunks.sol: And at that very moment, I could see it.

hunks.baseline: My lips, cracked completely dry, parted, and an exclamation escaped me.
hunks.sol: My parched lips parted, and an exclamation slipped out.

hunks.baseline: It was something I still had not realized, even after reaching the Supreme Peak.
hunks.sol: It was something I had yet to understand, even after reaching the Supreme Peak.

hunks.baseline: Along with a flash of insight that streaked through my mind like lightning, the slowed world returned to its proper speed.
hunks.sol: A flash of enlightenment streaked through my mind like lightning, and the slowed world resumed its proper speed.

hunks.baseline: Before the rain of spears pouring down and filling every direction, I raised my spear absentmindedly.
hunks.sol: Before the rain of spears pouring in from every direction, I raised my spear almost in a daze.

hunks.baseline: I brought White Flame down along the path I could see.
hunks.sol: Then I brought White Flame down along the path I could see.

hunks.baseline: The flames that erupted swallowed everything.

hunks.baseline: The things that vanished the instant the flames touched them were illusions made of magic.
hunks.sol: What vanished the instant the flames touched them were illusions made of magic.

hunks.baseline: Ash scattered in the wind that blew from somewhere.
hunks.sol: Ash scattered on a wind that blew from somewhere.

hunks.baseline: Amid the breeze, I heard a bright, cheerful ringing.
hunks.sol: Carried on that breeze, I heard a bright, cheerful ringing.

hunks.baseline: It was such a pleasant sound that I found myself smiling without realizing it.
